artifact_delivered: HMM model selection via BIC/AIC — K=6 wins universally across 4 assets, elbow at 3-5
workstream_summary: C541: Built bin/hmm_model_selection.py — sweeps K=2-6 with multi-seed Baum-Welch, computes BIC/AIC, identifies optimal K. All 4 assets (TSLA, NVDA, SPY, AAPL) select K=6. BIC elbow: NVDA=3, TSLA=4, SPY=4, AAPL=5. Confirms C540: HMMs learn mathematical decompositions, not market regimes.
